race.description: Kia Ora Bloodlines To Headlines Hcp (Bm72)
race.comment: COLUMBUS (2) lightly raced Dundeel gelding who can go quickly through the grades this time in. Continued where he left off last prep with a dominant first-up win over 1400m at Newcastle with the 60kg. J Mac takes the reins and can remain undefeated second-up. BARKING MAD (3) comes up from Victoria and remains undefeated this time in. Proved the Maiden win was no fluke with a dominant victory over 1400m at Sandown-Lakeside in the heavy going. Stalks the speed and has genuine each way prospects. DUSTY BAY (1) in career best form but faces a few hurdles here from the wide draw. Demolished a decent field as fav over 1400m at Warwick Farm second-up. Has the speed and talent to test this line-up with the claim. SPONARS (7) relished the jump in trip with a comfortable win over 1350m at Wyong as fav in BM68 class. Goes to a new pain barrier here but don't dismiss from the rails draw. FUNSHOW (4) returns from a let-up and remains undefeated this prep. Keep safe.
